Message:
net/mlx5e: Refactor rx_res_init() and rx_res_free() APIs

Refactor mlx5e_rx_res_init() and mlx5e_rx_res_free() by wrapping
mlx5e_rx_res_alloc() and mlx5e_rx_res_destroy() API's respectively.
